questions.category: Block D / Task 10 — Selects and Installs Electronic Components
questions.question: A furnace ignition module receives 24 V between TH and TR, but the spark output is intermittent. Flame sensor, ground, and wiring are clean and tight. What is the most likely next concern?
questions.explanation: If the control has proper input voltage and external wiring is verified, the module itself may be failing. Intermittent spark can be caused by weak internal electronics. A module should only be replaced after confirming power, ground, safeties, and ignition cable condition.

questions.category: Block D / Task 11 — Selects and Installs Electrical Components
questions.question: A 24 V transformer supplies a gas valve drawing 0.7 A, an ignition module drawing 0.4 A, and two relays drawing 0.2 A each. What minimum VA load is required?
questions.explanation: Total current = 0.7 + 0.4 + 0.2 + 0.2 = 1.5 A. VA = volts × amps = 24 × 1.5 = 36 VA. A transformer should be selected with adequate capacity above connected load.

questions.category: Block D / Task 12 — Installs Automation and Instrumentation Control Systems
questions.question: A building automation system sends a 0–10 V signal to modulate a burner, but the burner actuator is configured for 4–20 mA. What will happen?
options: The actuator may not respond correctly
The burner will safely run at perfect high fire
Flame safeguard timing will no longer matter
questions.explanation: Control signal type must match the actuator input. A voltage signal and current signal are not interchangeable. Incorrect configuration can cause improper firing rate control.

questions.category: Block E / Task 13 — Installs Gas-Fired System Piping and Equipment
questions.question: A gas pipe is cut and threaded, but the inside edge is not reamed. What is the most serious concern?
options: Burrs can restrict flow or break loose into controls
Gas pressure will become too high
The pipe will become electrically energized
The vent system will fail immediately
questions.explanation: Burrs create flow disturbance and possible restriction. Metal fragments can damage regulators, valves, and burner orifices. Pipe must be cleaned and reamed before assembly.

questions.category: Block E / Task 14 — Installs Gas-Fired System Components
questions.question: A regulator is installed backward even though pipe threads tighten correctly. What is the result?
options: Regulator may not control pressure properly
It will become a check valve approved for all uses
questions.explanation: Regulators are directional components. Flow arrows and manufacturer instructions must be followed. Reverse installation can cause unsafe pressure control.
